items.source: This method is invoked in the beginning of every request in contrast to saveOutputFlashMap(FlashMap, HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse), which is invoked only when there are flash attributes to be saved - i.e. before a redirect.
items.translation: 此方法在每个请求的开头被调用，而不同于saveOutputFlashMap(FlashMap, HttpServletRequest, HttpServletResponse)，后者仅在存在需要保存的 flash 属性时被调用——即在重定向之前。

items.source: NOTE: Invoke this method prior to a redirect in order to allow saving the FlashMap in the HTTP session or in a response cookie before the response is committed.
items.translation: 注意： 在重定向之前调用此方法，以便在提交响应之前将 FlashMap 保存到 HTTP 会话或响应 cookie 中。

items.source: A strategy interface for retrieving and saving FlashMap instances. See FlashMap for a general overview of flash attributes.
items.translation: 用于检索和保存 FlashMap 实例的策略接口。有关闪存属性的总体概述，请参阅FlashMap。

items.source: a FlashMap matching the current request or null
items.translation: 与当前请求匹配的 FlashMap 或null

items.source:
Find a FlashMap saved by a previous request that matches to the current
request, remove it from underlying storage, and also remove other
expired FlashMap instances.
items.translation: 查找由先前请求保存的与当前请求匹配的 FlashMap，将其从底层存储中移除，同时删除其他过期的 FlashMap 实例。

items.source:
Save the given FlashMap, in some underlying storage and set the start
of its expiration period.
items.translation: 将给定的 FlashMap 保存到某个底层存储中，并设置其过期周期的开始时间。
